description: Render backend (mgmt/server-render): eliminate the same-day chatbot lockout by (a) shrinking the per-answer system prompt dramatically in publicData.js and (b) raising the CHAT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET code default to a realistic launch value in config.js. Root cause: default budget 200,000 tokens/UTC-day divided by ~28,000 tokens per answer (the whole-portal system prompt sent on EVERY call) allows only ~7 answers before tokenBudgetExceeded() blocks every visitor with HTTP 503 until UTC midnight. The prompt size is the primary lever; the budget default is the safety margin. CACHE-ONLY throughout: no new fetch/D1. This feature is independent of FEAT-003 (frontend) and could be parallelized, but is ordered first.
steps: In mgmt/server-render/src/lib/publicData.js, reduce SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS from 6000 to a tighter cap (target ~3500) so the GENERAL (no-year) summary prompt is a few thousand chars (~1k-1.5k tokens) rather than a large multi-year dump. Keep the existing hard-cap truncation behavior (trim from the end so per-year totals + person block survive, journey trimmed first).

In summarizePortalData() (the GENERAL no-year path), bound the per-year sections harder: reduce the year window from years.slice(0,6) to a smaller recent-N (e.g. slice(0,3)) for per-year totals, top-contributors, and expenses; cap top contributors per year from 10 to a smaller number (e.g. 5); reduce committee years window (slice(0,8) -> slice(0,3)) and cap the committee name list length. Keep at least the recent per-year totals and the journey digest present. Do NOT touch the year-scoped path buildYearScopedContext() beyond what is needed (it is already small and correct) and do NOT change buildFullContext() row-by-row behavior other than confirming 'summary' remains the default (dataMode defaults to 'summary' in buildContextForProvider; verify the live provider path is NOT sending dataMode:'full').

In buildJourneySection() keep the PR#407 JOURNEY section but ensure the DEFAULT (non-full) digest stays short: keep it as span + grand total + best year + a bounded recent-years growth line (already slice(-6); reduce to slice(-3) for the non-full summary path) + tagline + up to ~4 title-only story highlights. Preserve the single-language directive (languageDirective) and the resell double-count note verbatim.

Preserve intact: ID->real-name resolution (buildNameResolver + safeName neutral-label degradation), per-person PERSON DETAILS block, DOCUMENT LINKS block, year-scoped retrieval (detectYears/buildYearScopedContext), the resell 'already counted' note, and the NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE.

In mgmt/server-render/src/config.js (~line 89), raise the code DEFAULT for chatDailyTokenBudget from 200000 to a realistic launch value of 2000000 (two million tokens/UTC-day). Keep it read from env: parseInt(opt('CHAT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET','2000000'),10) || 2000000, so operators can still override on Render. Update the inline comment to explain the number (with the smaller ~3-4k-token/answer prompt after this change, 2,000,000 tokens serves roughly 500+ answers/day; raise via env for more headroom).
Update mgmt/server-render/.env.example CHAT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET example/comment if present to reflect the new default and note it can be raised on Render.

Add a Render test in mgmt/server-render/test/ (e.g. chatBudget.test.mjs using node:test) that imports chatGuards.js and config.js and proves: (1) with the default budget, a realistic number of answers fit — simulate recording a realistic per-answer cost (e.g. ~4000 tokens) many times and assert tokenBudgetExceeded() stays false for at least, say, 100 answers; (2) tokenBudgetExceeded() still trips exactly once cumulative tokensUsed >= config.chatDailyTokenBudget (record tokens up to/over the limit and assert it becomes true). Use _resetBudget()/_tokensUsed() seams. Note config is read at import; set env before import or assert relative to config.chatDailyTokenBudget rather than a hardcoded number.

Add a publicData test (extend mgmt/server-render/test/publicChat.test.mjs or a new file) that builds a LARGE multi-year dataset (e.g. 10+ years, many contributors/committee rows) and asserts: (1) summarizePortalData(bigData, '') stays under the reduced SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS cap (length <= cap + small truncation slack); (2) it still includes at least the most recent per-year totals line (e.g. /Year 20\d\d: collections/) and a JOURNEY digest line (e.g. /JOURNEY|Total collected across the whole journey/); (3) a year-scoped question (naming a present year) still returns that year's totals.

Run `cd mgmt/server-render && npm test` and confirm the full suite (existing 221 + new tests) is green. Fix any existing test that asserted the old 6000 cap or old per-year windows only if it now legitimately conflicts — prefer keeping existing assertions valid; if the existing 'summary must stay compact' (<4000) test already passes it should continue to.
acceptance_criteria: config.chatDailyTokenBudget default is 2000000 when CHAT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET is unset, still overridable via env.
For a large multi-year dataset, summarizePortalData(data,'') output length stays under the new reduced cap while still containing recent per-year totals and a journey digest.
New Render test proves >=100 realistic answers fit under the default budget AND tokenBudgetExceeded() trips at config.chatDailyTokenBudget.
The year-scoped path, per-person block, document links, resell note, ID->name resolution, journey section, and single-language directive all remain functional (existing tests still pass).
`cd mgmt/server-render && npm test` is green with >=221 + new tests passing, 0 fail.
verification: Run `cd mgmt/server-render && npm test` and confirm 0 failures with the new budget and publicData tests passing.

Confirm no new fetch()/D1 calls were introduced in publicData.js (grep for fetch within the summary/journey builders — only the pre-existing getJson/currentVersion/getPortalData paths may call fetch).
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (Render backend only; frontend untouched). Changes:

config.js (~line 89): chatDailyTokenBudget default raised 200000 -> 2000000, kept env-overridable: parseInt(opt('CHAT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET','2000000'),10)||2000000, with an expanded comment explaining ~500+ answers/day at the reduced prompt size. .env.example does NOT mention CHAT_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET (grep confirmed absent), so nothing to update there.

publicData.js: SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS reduced 6000 -> 3500 (new value = 3500). Tightened the GENERAL (no-year) summarizePortalData path only: per-year totals years.slice(0,6)->slice(0,3); top contributors years.slice(0,6)->slice(0,3) and per-year cap 10->5; per-year expenses years.slice(0,6)->slice(0,3) with item cap 8->5; loans per-year loanYears.slice(0,6)->slice(0,3); committee cYears.slice(0,8)->slice(0,3) with name-list cap added/reduced to 8 (both the per-year and the no-year fallback list). Journey digest (buildJourneySection): default (non-full) recent-growth window slice(-6)->slice(-3); story highlights slice(0,6)->slice(0,4) for the default digest (full mode keeps 6/12 so buildFullContext is unchanged in spirit). The year-scoped path buildYearScopedContext and buildFullContext row logic were NOT altered. 'summary' remains the default dataMode in buildContextForProvider (mode = provider.dataMode || 'summary'). All preserved: buildNameResolver + safeName neutral-label degradation, PERSON DETAILS block, DOCUMENT LINKS block, detectYears/buildYearScopedContext, resell 'already counted' note, PR#407 JOURNEY section (now a short digest), languageDirective, NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE, MAX_ANSWER_TOKENS (512). No new fetch()/D1 introduced (only the pre-existing getJson fetch remains).

SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS = 3500. Budget default = 2000000. Per-call token estimate after shrink: data prompt capped at 3500 chars ~= 875 tokens (chars/4); with preamble already counted inside the cap, plus the user question and up to 512 completion tokens, a full answer is roughly 1.5k-4k tokens. At the conservative 4000-tokens/answer test figure, 2,000,000/4000 = 500 answers/day (vs ~7 before the fix).

TESTS: new test/chatBudget.test.mjs (node:test) proves (a) 100 answers at ~4000 tokens stay under the default budget (tokenBudgetExceeded false), (b) tokenBudgetExceeded() trips exactly at config.chatDailyTokenBudget, asserted relative to config (env not set so config = shipped default 2000000; also asserts default==2000000 and 500+ affordable). Extended test/publicChat.test.mjs with a 12-year/60-contributors-per-year/20-committee-per-year dataset: general summary length <= 3600 (cap+slack), still matches /Year 20\d\d: collections/ and /JOURNEY|Total collected across the whole journey/, and a year-scoped question about 2016 (outside the recent-3 window) still returns /Year 2016: collections/ and stays <= 3600.

VERIFICATION: `cd mgmt/server-render && npm test` => 228 pass / 0 fail (baseline 221 + 7 new). Existing 'summary must stay compact' (<4000) and 'hard-capped' (<=6100) assertions still pass with the smaller cap. Did NOT commit/push per orchestrator instructions.

FOLLOW-UP (semantic review concern #3, test-only, no production change): added ONE additive node:test to test/publicChat.test.mjs reusing the existing buildBigDataset() helper (12 years 2013..2024, 60 contributors/year). The test pins BOTH sides of the FEAT-002 trade-off on the SAME older year 2016: summarizePortalData(big,'') (GENERAL, no literal year) does NOT contain /Year 2016: collections/ while DOES contain a recent in-window /Year 2024: collections/ (proves the window boundary, not just absence), and summarizePortalData(big,'...2016...') (year-scoped) DOES contain /Year 2016: collections/. No existing tests or production code modified. `cd mgmt/server-render && npm test` => 229 pass / 0 fail (confirmed stable across 3 consecutive runs). Status unchanged (already completed).
